subject.title: [Feature]: Make detached longwork final delivery ownership explicit

question: Should this issue remain the canonical home for detached-longwork final-delivery ownership, and which existing substrate should own the durable obligation: subagent completion delivery, outbound send/retry state, or a broader plugin/lifecycle delivery boundary?
rationale: The source gap is clear, but the requested contract defines public delivery semantics and durable session-state ownership rather than a narrow mechanical bug fix.

options.title: Use Existing Delivery State
options.body: Extend the current subagent/outbound delivery state so final delivery remains pending until confirmed, failed, suppressed, or cancelled with an owner-visible reason.

options.title: Define A New Owner-Mode API
options.body: Revisit a smaller version of the completionOwner API after maintainers accept the exact model/plugin-facing values, default behavior, and live proof bar.

options.title: Move To Adjacent Canonical Work
options.body: If this invariant belongs under Slack origin-tuples, plugin completion hooks, or background-work lifecycle instead, close this design thread only after linking the chosen canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Use Existing Delivery State
recommendation.body: Extend the current subagent/outbound delivery state so final delivery remains pending until confirmed, failed, suppressed, or cancelled with an owner-visible reason.

likelyOwner.reason: He is the strongest available decision router from the requester-routing merge, adjacent delivery comments, and API/default review history.
